admissible_claims: Nueva Esperanza historically routed directly to El Zanjón but urban development altered its morphology and routing toward the 13 de Julio sector
La Piscina historically joined Nueva Esperanza and then El Zanjón
the source supports separating historical drainage topology from present-day unresolved urban routing
